description: C++23 campaign runtime and SDL3/Vulkan client with durable Player17 saves, native research, fleet navigation and shipyard workspaces. Shipbuilding uses canonical precommit costs and population readiness, timed orders and confirmed refunds. Research and shipyards display source sovereign currencies. No Godot or .NET runtime is required. Construction/unlock progression, full production visuals, colony/system/diplomacy screens and audio remain unfinished. Diagnostic timings are not an FPS guarantee.
